artifact_vs_original.note: export_size_bytes recorded per-precision in run_experiment JSON; total_compressed_bytes is canonical size metric

before_after_vs_M1a.kernels_group_wall: M1a 58.12s vs M1b 35.37s — variance is machine load, not a code change (same 211 pass)
before_after_vs_M1a.verdict: no drift; M1a and M1b agree to 3 decimals on all fixture metrics

methodology.load: cold = fresh `python3 -c load_model()` wall via /usr/bin/time; reload = second load_model() in same process (file cache + imports hot); RSS = resource.ru_maxrss after one load
methodology.pytest: per-module `pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`, wall via /usr/bin/time -p; each group run once, sequentially, no other heavy processes controlled for — wall times are indicative, pass/fail is authoritative
methodology.ratio_definition: total_original_size_bytes / (compressed + scales); MAE/MSE/max/rel-err are param-count-weighted means over 17 tensors from run_experiment.py
methodology.transform_s: stage-duration seconds recorded by pipeline TRANSFORM stage (INT4 dominated by group-wise quant loop)
